Speaker: Lira
Text: The Fade is everywhere now. I can see through the walls of reality — the Overworld, the Nexus, all of it. Layered like glass.

Speaker: Lira
Text: Dad is in the Nexus. I can feel his heartbeat through the data streams. Stubborn as ever.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I'm not the girl he remembers. The Fade wove itself into me — I'm part of this place now.

Speaker: Lira
Text: But I'm still me. Still Lira. Still his daughter. That part — the Fade can't take.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I'll hold on, Dad. No matter what I've become — I'll hold on.
